title: Saksi nyang Teuga
intro: Saboh narasi nyang mendalam meulangsong, geupeugah keu tekad nyang hana meugoyang dari saboh masyarakat lam geuhadapi tirani nyang that rayeuk. Kisah awaknyan jeuet keu bukti iman, bahpih watee geuhadapi ngon pengorbanan nyang paleng rayeuk. Catatan nyoe geupeuingat geutanyoe keuhai kuasa iman ateuh penindasan nyang lumpah that.
clues: Kamoe nakeuh saboh keulompok nyang kisah jih geuceurita lom lam saboh surah nyang paneuk dan meukuasa, peuingat keuhai peuaniayaan.
Kamoe meuhadap ngon sidroe peunguasa nyang keuneuk peugadoh keuyakinan kamoe keu Allah nyang Esa, Tuhan Tahta, Nyang Pujoe.
Kamoe keunong ujian nyang that-that teumakot nyang meulibatkan saboh lueng nyang rayeuk that nyang jikueh lam bumoe.
Kamoe meungieng watee ureueng-ureueng meuiman, teumasok aneuk miet mantong manyak, jitiek lam nuraka nyang meu-ulang-ulang lam kulah nyan.
Ureuëng-ureuëng njang siksa kamoë ka djikutuk ateuëh buët-buët awaknjan, seudangkan kamoë ka djidjak janji pahala njang rajek that ateuëh keu-teugahan kamoë.
Usaha peunguasa untôk peumaté iman geutanjoë mantong geupeukong teumpat geutanjoë sibagoë sjahid di sisi Allah, njang saksi ateuëh bandum hai.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
